components.name: Hallmark Purity Badge
components.description: Purity stamp on product media; dashed border marks 80%/60% alloys.
components.css: .ds-hallmark { display:inline-block; font:400 0.8rem Marcellus, Georgia, serif; letter-spacing:0.06em; color:#2F3B5E; padding:0.3rem 0.55rem 0.25rem; border:1px solid #2F3B5E; border-radius:0 0 0.8rem 0.8rem; background:rgba(248,249,248,0.85); } .ds-hallmark.alloy { border-style:dashed; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height:2.75rem; padding:0.9rem 1.6rem; font:500 0.95rem 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; background:#2F3B5E; color:#F8F9F8; border:1px solid #2F3B5E; border-radius:2px; transition:background 250ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background:#24304D; }

narrative.overview: Exact and unhurried, like a jeweller's record book: purity, finish, weight and price set down plainly. Warmth comes from the family story and the silver, not decoration. Dark story/hero sections, light shopping pages.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo is reserved for actions, focus and purity facts.

rules.name: The Contrast Gate Rule
rules.body: Colour pairs ship only if tokens:build passes WCAG AA.

rules.name: The Ledger Numerals Rule
rules.body: Prices, weights and percentages use tabular numerals at 600.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow; state shown by tone or border.

dos: Do read values only from --argiva-* variables
Do show purity, finish, weight and price on every card and PDP
Do guard all motion with prefers-reduced-motion
donts: Don't hard-code hex values in components
Don't spread the ghungroo divider beyond Our Story and Anklets
